question: Which of the following is a connective tissue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Blood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blood** is a type of **connective tissue**.
 
• It consists of **cells** suspended in a **liquid matrix** called **plasma**.
 
• Blood performs various **essential functions** such as **transporting oxygen and nutrients** to the cells and removing waste products.
 
• It also plays a crucial role in the **immune system** and in **regulating body temperature**.
 
• Components of blood include **red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets,** and **plasma**.
 
• **Red blood cells (RBCs)** are responsible for carrying **oxygen** from the lungs to the rest of the body.
 
• **White blood cells (WBCs)** are involved in protecting the body against infections.
 
• **Platelets** help in **blood clotting** and wound healing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cuboidal Epithelium**__

 __
 
• **Cuboidal epithelium** is a type of **epithelial tissue** that consists of cube-shaped cells.
 
• It is found in various organs such as the **kidney tubules** and **glands**.
 
• The primary function of cuboidal epithelium is **secretion and absorption**.
 
 
 
• **Muscle**__
 __
 
• **Muscle tissue** is responsible for **movement** in the body.
 
• There are three types of muscle tissues: **skeletal, cardiac,** and **smooth muscle**.
 
• Skeletal muscles are involved in **voluntary movements**, while cardiac and smooth muscles control **involuntary functions**.
 
 
 
• **Columnar Epithelium**__
 
 
• **Columnar epithelium** consists of elongated cells that are taller than they are wide.
 
• This type of epithelium is found in the **digestive tract** and is specialized for **absorption and secretion**.
 
• It often contains **goblet cells** which secrete mucus.
